definitions.r1: Asymmetric block injection only: h[0]-=g0, h[1]+=ROTR64(g0,19), h[2]+=g1, h[3]-=ROTR64(g1,41). Breaks pair-sum coset invariant (W1).
definitions.r2: Feistel cross-coupled mixA only: adds a ^= d; c ^= b; at the end of mixA. Breaks pair-separability (W2) and cures dead-word h[0]'' in finalization (W3).
definitions.r3: Hardened core (R1 + R2): asymmetric injection + Feistel cross-coupled mixA.
definitions.r4: R3 + 4-lane lossless output squeeze: g = (h[0] ^ h[2]) - (h[1] ^ h[3]). Eliminates -sigma_2 output readout (W3, W4).
definitions.r5: R4 + nonlinear domain-separated seed/length/width initialization. Eliminates additive seed correlation and cross-width prefixing (W4, W5).
definitions.r6: Zero-latency cross-coupled core (R1 asymmetric injection + b^=c, d^=a, s=[b,c,d,a] in mixA + 4-lane squeeze). Fixes W1–W4 at zero extra mixA instructions.
